entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-11-27
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Regression in 11.0.0: Scaffold-DbContext fails with "Invalid column name 'temporal_type'" on SQL Server 2012/2014 #39836
  • GroupBy element `OrderBy(...).First()`/`MaxBy` over an owned type mapped to its own table fails to translate #39833
    12.0.0

Closed

  • Question on possibility of general RelationalShapedQueryCompilingExpressionExpressionVisitor updates #39534
    Discussions
